user.title: Connect your ePiXeL screen
user.description: On the screen go to Settings > Home Assistant > Find server. Enter the 4-digit code shown on the screen.

error.no_device: No screen is requesting to pair with that code. Is the code still on the screen? Codes expire after 3 minutes.

abort.already_configured: An ePiXeL screen is already connected. Remove the existing entry before pairing again.
abort.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Generate a new code on the screen and try again.

init.title: ePiXeL pages
init.description: Build the pages shown on the screen. Each page holds up to 6 boxes.

error.too_many_entities: A page holds at most 6 entities. Put the rest on a new page.

abort.too_many_pages: You can create at most 8 pages.
